description: Find about 10 Airbnb rentals in any city with title, type, guests, rating, price, location and link as JSON. Built for travel agents. No account needed. Use it when: A travel task needs holiday rentals in a city rather than hotels, with ratings and prices. Not for: Booking a stay; it returns links, it does not reserve. Returns: About 10 rentals: title, type, guests, rating, price, location, thumbnail and link. Typical time: about 18 s. Price: $0.056 per call, charged only on success. One call = one result.
name: airbnb-search
title: Airbnb rentals by city
